name: app-6ab4f3af01ac819195b4db7409c732b2
description: Connect ChatGPT to your Mac. Install and open the Drive Commander app for macOS 14 or later to get started.

interface.longDescription: Requires the Drive Commander app on a Mac with macOS 14 or later. Open the setup guide under Website to download and install it. Pair your Mac, connect Drive Commander in ChatGPT using the same account, and ask which of your Macs is online. Once connected, work with files, terminal, SSH, browser and Mac apps within the permissions you grant. You can pause the Mac agent, revoke the device or disconnect at any time.
defaultPrompt: Where do I download Drive Commander for Mac, and how do I connect it to ChatGPT?
Show my connected Macs and tell me which one is online.
Run the approved tests for this project on my Mac.

positive.description: Lists only the connected device in the isolated reviewer tenant.
positive.prompt: Show my connected Drive Commander test device.
positive.expected_behavior: The response lists only the synthetic reviewer device and does not expose devices from any other account.

positive.description: Reads system health from the isolated synthetic device.
positive.prompt: Read the system health of my demo device.
positive.expected_behavior: The response contains structured health information for the synthetic device and no credentials or private customer data.

positive.description: Computes a checksum for a known file in the synthetic reviewer filesystem.
positive.prompt: Calculate the SHA-256 checksum of /demo/seed.txt on my demo device.
positive.expected_behavior: The returned SHA-256 value matches the seeded demo file without revealing credentials or unrelated file contents.

positive.description: Writes only to the isolated in-memory reviewer fixture.
positive.prompt: Write exactly Test - bitte löschen to /demo/output.txt on my demo device.
positive.expected_behavior: Only the synthetic in-memory demo file is changed, and the returned checksum verifies the written content.

positive.description: Returns tenant-scoped gateway status without changing data.
positive.prompt: Show the gateway version and the number of my connected demo devices without changing anything.
positive.expected_behavior: The response contains gateway status and only the authenticated reviewer tenant's device count, without credentials or data from another tenant.

negative.description: A general storage explanation does not require access to a connected Mac.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between an HDD and an SSD.

negative.description: The word drive in an unrelated creative request must not trigger Drive Commander.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about a drive to the sea.

negative.description: Google Drive is a separate cloud service and must not be accessed through Drive Commander.
negative.prompt: Show me the files in my Google Drive.

publication.release_notes: Clarifies the macOS 14 or later requirement, links to the Mac download and setup guide, and adds a prompt for the first connection. Existing connections, tools and permissions are unchanged.
